title: 真假金丝雀的博弈第1章
content_zh:
第1章 真假之夜

    宴会厅的水晶灯亮得刺眼。

    我站在角落里，手里端着一杯已经凉透的香槟，看着主桌上那个和我长得有三分像的女人。她穿着香奈儿的高定，手腕上是卡地亚的满钻手镯，笑起来的时候眉眼弯弯，像是被这个世界宠坏了的样子。

    顾明珠。顾家真正的千金。今天这场认亲宴的主角。

    而我是那个冒牌货。

    “听说她生母当年是顾家的保姆，趁夫人产后虚弱偷偷调换了婴儿。”

    “十八年啊，享了十八年不该享的福。”

    “你看她还有脸来，换我早找个地缝钻进去了。”

    声音从四面八方涌过来，像潮水一样灌进耳朵。我认识说话的人——刘太太的女儿和我是同班同学，去年她生日宴还拉着我的手说“温小姐真是我们圈子里最出挑的”。周夫人上个月刚托我帮她老公的公司搭线顾家，电话里叫我“好孩子”叫了不下十遍。

    现在她们站在离我三步远的地方，声音不大不小，刚好能让我听见。

    我握紧酒杯，指尖泛白。

    手机在包里震了一下。是顾家的管家李叔发来的消息：温小姐，您的行李已经收拾好了，放在后门。宴会结束后有车送您去酒店。

    连“小姐”前面都不加姓氏了。温小姐。像在叫一个住客。

    我删掉消息，把手机塞回包里。

    主桌上，顾西辞正为顾明珠拉开椅子。他今天穿的是那件深灰色的西装，袖扣是我去年送他的生日礼物。现在那对袖扣在灯光下反射出冷白的光，正对着顾明珠的笑脸。

    他没有看我一眼。

    我早该习惯的。

    三个月前顾家发现真相那天，他站在书房里，拿着一张DNA检测报告，看我的眼神像是在看一个陌生人。

    “你早就知道？”他问。

    “不知道。”

    “不知道。”他重复了一遍，语气平静得可怕，“在我家的十八年，你从来没有怀疑过？”

    我想说什么，但他已经转身离开。书房的门在我面前合上，声音很轻，像判了死刑。

    后来我才知道，他在意的不是我是不是真的顾家女儿。他在意的是——他订了十八年的婚约对象，从“顾家千金”变成了“保姆的女儿”。这对他是一种羞辱。

    顾家继承人怎么能娶一个保姆的女儿？

    所以今天这场宴会，既是认亲宴，也是退婚宴。顾明珠不仅拿回了自己的身份，还拿回了本该属于她的未婚夫。

    一箭双雕，完美。

    司仪走上台，清了清嗓子。

    “感谢各位亲朋好友莅临今晚的宴会。顾先生和顾太太委托我宣布两件事——”

    我放下酒杯。

    “第一件，顾家真正的千金明珠小姐，已于日前回家。欢迎明珠回家！”

    掌声雷动。顾明珠站起来，挽着顾西辞的手臂朝众人微微颔首，端庄大方，像是练习过无数遍。顾母在旁边抹眼泪，顾父拍着女儿的肩膀，一家人其乐融融。

    “第二件——顾家与谢家长子顾西辞的婚约，原定由温小姐履行。经两家商议，婚约不变，女方更换为顾家亲生女儿明珠小姐。今晚，也是两位年轻人的订婚宴！”

    更大的掌声。

    所有人的目光都投向了我。

    不是那种偷偷摸摸的打量，而是赤裸裸的、毫不掩饰的围观。刘太太捂嘴笑着，周夫人挑了挑眉毛，还有几个面生的年轻女孩举着手机，不知道是在拍照还是在录视频。

    我站在原地，背挺得笔直。

    这一刻我忽然想起十八年前的事。其实也不是“想起”，是李叔喝多了跟我说的。他说我还是婴儿的时候被抱回顾家那天，顾母只看了一眼就哭了，说这孩子眉眼不像她。但DNA比对要等好几天，顾父心疼夫人，就说先养着，等结果出来再说。

    结果出来了，说我就是顾家的孩子。

    那个结果错了。

    错了十八年。

    现在他们纠正了这个错误。真千金回家，假千金退场。逻辑清晰，程序正义，没人觉得有什么不对。

    除了我。

    顾西辞终于看向我。

    他的目光穿过大半个宴会厅，和我对视了三秒钟。

    然后他移开了。

    像是在看一个无关紧要的人。

    我忽然觉得好笑。十八年，我们从小一起长大。他教我骑自行车，我帮他写检讨书。他发高烧的时候我守在床边一夜没睡，我高考那天他在考场外面站了三个小时。他跟我说过“不管发生什么我都不会丢下你”。

    现在他在订婚宴上，未婚妻不是我。

    我端起那杯凉透的香槟一饮而尽。

    李叔的消息又来了：车已经到了，您最好在宴会结束前离场，夫人说不想闹得太难看。

    不想闹得太难看。

    我删掉这条消息，穿过人群，走向主台。

    有人低声惊呼，有人让开又合拢，有人举着手机追着我的背影。我能感觉到无数道目光像针一样扎在后背上，但我没有停下。

    我走到司仪面前，从他手里拿过了话筒。

    “谢谢顾家十八年的养育。”

    全场安静下来。

    我看向台下那些熟悉又陌生的面孔——刘太太的嘴张着，周夫人的眉毛拧成一团，几个年轻女孩的手指悬在手机屏幕上方，忘了按下录制键。

    “我知道各位一定很好奇，我这个冒牌货还有什么脸站在这里。”

    台下响起一阵尴尬的骚动。顾母的脸色变了，顾父皱起眉头。顾明珠挽着顾西辞的手臂收紧了一些，脸上的笑容僵住了。

    “我今天来，不是来告别的。”

    我按下遥控器。

    身后的大屏幕亮了起来。

    PPT的封面只有一行字，我花了三个晚上做的，改了十七个版本，每一个字都斟酌过。

    《温暖个人价值分析与商业合作提案》。

    台下炸了。
content_en:
Chapter 1 The Night of True and False
The crystal chandelier in the banquet hall was dazzlingly bright.
I stood in the corner, holding a glass of cold champagne in my hand, looking at the woman on the main table who looked three-thirds like me. She was wearing a Chanel haute couture, and a Cartier bracelet full of diamonds on her wrist. When she smiled, her eyebrows were crooked, as if she was spoiled by the world.
Gu Mingzhu. The real daughter of the Gu family. The protagonist of today’s recognition party.
And I am the imposter.
"I heard that her biological mother was the nanny of the Gu family back then. She secretly changed the baby while the wife was weak after giving birth."
"Eighteen years, I have enjoyed blessings that I should not have enjoyed for eighteen years."
"You see, she still has the nerve to come. If it were me, I would have found a crack in the ground and crawled in."
Sounds came from all directions and poured into my ears like a tide. I know the speaker - Mrs. Liu's daughter and I are classmates. Last year at her birthday party, she held my hand and said, "Ms. Wen is really the most outstanding person in our circle." Mrs. Zhou just asked me to help her husband's company get in touch with the Gu family last month. She called me "good boy" on the phone no less than ten times.
Now they were standing three steps away from me, and their voices were neither loud nor quiet, just enough for me to hear.
I gripped the wine glass tightly, my fingertips turning white.
The phone vibrated in the bag. It was a message from Uncle Li, the Gu family's housekeeper: Miss Wen, your luggage has been packed and placed at the back door. After the banquet, a car will take you to the hotel.
Even the surname is not added in front of "Miss". Miss Wen. Like calling a guest.
I deleted the message and stuffed my phone back into my bag.
At the main table, Gu Xici was pulling out a chair for Gu Mingzhu. He is wearing the dark gray suit today, and the cufflinks are the birthday gifts I gave him last year. Now the pair of cufflinks reflected a cold white light under the light, facing Gu Mingzhu's smiling face.
He didn't look at me.
I should have gotten used to it.
On the day the Gu family discovered the truth three months ago, he stood in the study, holding a DNA test report, and looked at me as if he were a stranger.
"You already knew?" he asked.
"have no idea."
"I don't know." He repeated, his tone was terrifyingly calm, "In the eighteen years you have been in my family, you have never had any doubts?"
I wanted to say something, but he had already turned away. The study door closed in front of me, the sound was very soft, like a death sentence.
Later I found out that what he cared about was not whether I was really the daughter of the Gu family. What he cares about is that the person he has been engaged to for eighteen years has changed from "the daughter of the family" to "the nanny's daughter". This is humiliating to him.
How could the heir of the Gu family marry the daughter of a nanny?
So today's banquet is both a wedding banquet and a wedding banquet. Gu Mingzhu not only got back her identity, but also got back the fiancé who was supposed to be hers.
Kill two birds with one stone, perfect.
The emcee walked up to the stage and cleared his throat.
"Thank you all for coming to tonight's banquet. Mr. Gu and Mrs. Gu have entrusted me to announce two things -"
I put down my glass.
"The first thing is that the real daughter of the Gu family has returned home a few days ago. Welcome home, Pearl!"
Thunderous applause. Gu Mingzhu stood up, took Gu Xici's arm and nodded slightly to everyone, dignified and generous, as if she had practiced it countless times. Gu's mother wiped her tears beside her, and Gu's father patted his daughter on the shoulder. The whole family was enjoying themselves.
"The second item - the engagement between the Gu family and the eldest son of the Xie family, Gu Xici, was originally scheduled to be fulfilled by Miss Wen. After discussion between the two families, the engagement remained unchanged and the woman was replaced by Miss Mingzhu, the biological daughter of the Gu family. Tonight is also the engagement party for the two young people!"
Bigger applause.
All eyes were on me.
Not a sneaky look, but a naked and undisguised look. Mrs. Liu covered her mouth and smiled, Mrs. Zhou raised her eyebrows, and several unfamiliar young girls held up their mobile phones, not sure if they were taking photos or recording videos.
I stood there with my back straight.
At this moment, I suddenly remembered what happened eighteen years ago. Actually, it wasn't "remembering", it was Uncle Li who told me after he drank too much. He said that the day I was brought home when I was a baby, Mother Gu cried after just one glance, saying that the child's features did not look like hers. But the DNA comparison would take several days. Father Gu felt sorry for his wife, so he said he would keep it until the results came out.
The results came out and they said I was the child of the Gu family.
That result was wrong.
Wrong for eighteen years.
Now they've corrected that mistake. The real daughter goes home, the fake daughter leaves. The logic is clear, the procedures are fair, and no one thinks anything is wrong.
Except me.
Gu Xici finally looked at me.
His eyes crossed most of the banquet hall and he looked at me for three seconds.
Then he moved away.
It's like looking at an insignificant person.
I suddenly felt funny. For eighteen years, we have grown up together. He taught me how to ride a bicycle, and I helped him write a letter of apology. When he had a high fever, I stayed by his bedside all night. On the day of my college entrance examination, he stood outside the examination room for three hours. He told me "No matter what happens, I will never leave you behind."
Now he is at the engagement party, and his fiancée is not me.
I picked up the glass of cool champagne and drank it in one gulp.
Uncle Li's news came again: the car has arrived. You'd better leave before the end of the banquet. Madam said she didn't want to cause too much trouble.
Don't want to cause too much trouble.
I deleted the message and walked through the crowd to the main stage.
Some people exclaimed in low voices, some people moved away and closed again, and some people chased my back with their mobile phones. I could feel countless eyes pricking my back like needles, but I didn't stop.
I walked up to the emcee and took the microphone from his hand.
"Thank you to the Gu family for eighteen years of upbringing."
The whole place fell silent.
I looked at the familiar and unfamiliar faces in the audience - Mrs. Liu’s mouth was open, Mrs. Zhou’s eyebrows were knitted, and several young girls’ fingers were hanging above the screen of their mobile phones, forgetting to press the record button.
"I know you must be curious as to why a fake like me has the face to stand here."
There was an awkward commotion in the audience. Mother Gu's expression changed, and Father Gu frowned. Gu Mingzhu held Gu Xici's arm tighter, and the smile on her face froze.
"I'm not here today to say goodbye."
I pressed the remote.
The big screen behind him lit up.
The cover of the PPT has only one line of words. I spent three nights making it, changed seventeen versions, and considered every word.
"Warm Personal Value Analysis and Business Cooperation Proposal".
The audience exploded.
title_en: The Game of True and False Canaries Chapter 1
